title: But Hamlet is so personal, isn’t it? Mr Best pleaded. I mean, a kind of private paper, don’t you know, of his private life. I mean, I don’t care a button, don’t you know, who is killed or who is guilty...
html_source:
Gifford ; Annotated Ulysses

In the 19th century, Hamlet was perceived to be the most autobiographical of WS' plays. 19th C readers were into the life of the writers!

Let us not forget Freud – 1856-1939.
